repair.title: Clean Energy Work Grew
repair.summary: IRENA reports that global renewable energy jobs rose to 16.2 million in 2023, up from 13.7 million in 2022.
repair.why_it_matters: The energy transition is not only machinery; it is also a growing base of people trained to build and maintain it.
repair.caveat: Jobs are unevenly distributed by region, technology, and working conditions.
